# Core

Every scene is built from these: placement, surfaces, lights, reflection probes, cameras, process modes and the scene-wide environment.

## `transform` { #transform }

Position, rotation (Euler degrees) and scale relative to the parent entity.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | number[3] | Position in meters relative to parent; +Y is up |  |
| `rotation` | number[3] | Euler angles in degrees [pitch(X), yaw(Y), roll(Z)] |  |
| `scale` | number[3] | Scale factor per axis |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"transform": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.transform.position          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `mesh` { #mesh }

Renders a mesh with a simple physically based material.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh` | string | Primitive (cube, sphere, plane, cylinder, cone, quad, capsule, torus) or "asset:&lt;path&gt;" (.obj/.glb/.gltf) |  |
| `color` | color | Base color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `metallic` | number | 0 = dielectric, 1 = metal | 0 .. 1 |
| `roughness` | number | 0 = mirror, 1 = matte | 0.02 .. 1 |
| `emissive` | color | Emitted light color; alpha is strength — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `texture` | string | Optional albedo texture path (png/jpg), relative to project |  |
| `visible` | boolean | Whether the mesh is drawn |  |
| `billboard` | boolean | Always face the camera (useful for 2D sprites) |  |
| `material` | string | Material asset path (*.mat.json); when set it overrides color/metallic/roughness/emissive/texture |  |
| `unlit` | boolean | Flat color/texture without lighting (2D, UI, stylized) |  |
| `shading` | string | pbr = physically based, toon = cel bands + crisp highlights, unlit = flat, water = animated waves (use on a large plane; color = deep water tint) | `pbr` `toon` `unlit` `water` |
| `normalMap` | string | Normal map (png), project-relative; adds surface detail |  |
| `ormMap` | string | Occlusion/roughness/metallic map (R/G/B, glTF convention) |  |
| `emissiveMap` | string | Emission mask/color map, multiplied with emissive |  |
| `normalStrength` | number | Normal map strength | 0 .. 4 |
| `tiling` | number | Texture repeats (per meter when triplanar) | 0.01 .. 1000 |
| `triplanar` | boolean | Project textures in world space: no stretching on scaled shapes |  |
| `clearcoat` | number | Glossy lacquer layer on top (car paint, varnish) | 0 .. 1 |
| `subsurface` | number | Light bleeding through (skin, leaves, wax, snow) | 0 .. 1 |
| `rim` | number | Stylized rim light along silhouettes | 0 .. 4 |
| `outline` | number | Cartoon outline width in pixels (0 = none) | 0 .. 12 |
| `outlineColor` | color | Outline color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `doubleSided` | boolean | Render both faces (leaves, cloth, cards) |  |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Cast sun shadows |  |
| `alphaCutoff` | number | Alpha-tested cutout: texture alpha below this is cut (foliage, fences, sails); 0 = off | 0 .. 1 |
| `layers` | integer | Render layers bitmask (bit 0 = layer 1 .. bit 19 = layer 20; default 1). A camera draws the mesh when its cullMask shares a bit; a light lights it when the light's cullMask does. Name layers in game.json and set them by name with render_layers |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"mesh": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.mesh.mesh          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `light` { #light }

A light source. Directional lights use the entity rotation; point/spot use position.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | Light type | `directional` `point` `spot` |
| `color` | color | Light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `intensity` | number | Brightness multiplier | 0 .. 1000 |
| `range` | number | Falloff distance in meters (point/spot) | 0.01 .. 10000 |
| `spotAngle` | number | Cone half-angle in degrees (spot) | 1 .. 89 |
| `cullMask` | integer | Render layers this light illuminates (bitmask, bit 0 = layer 1; default all 20). E.g. a rim light that only lights the hero: put the hero on layer 2 and set cullMask 2 |  |
| `specular` | number | Specular highlight strength (0 = diffuse only) | 0 .. 16 |
| `indirect` | number | Contribution to world-space GI (reserved for GI probes / lightmaps) | 0 .. 16 |
| `volumetric` | number | Strength in volumetric light / god rays (environment godRays) | 0 .. 16 |
| `temperature` | number | Color temperature in Kelvin, multiplied with color (1900 candle, 2700 tungsten, 4000 fluorescent, 5500 noon, 6500 white, 9000 overcast sky); 0 = off | 0 .. 40000 |
| `innerAngle` | number | Spot: half-angle of the full-intensity inner cone in degrees (0 = automatic); smaller = softer edge | 0 .. 89 |
| `negative` | boolean | Subtract light instead of adding it (stylized darkening) |  |
| `distanceFade` | boolean | Fade the light out with distance from the camera (cheap crowds of small lights) |  |
| `fadeBegin` | number | Distance fade: meters from the camera where fading starts | 0 .. 100000 |
| `fadeLength` | number | Distance fade: meters over which the light fades out | 0.01 .. 100000 |
| `attenuation` | string | Falloff: smooth = soft artist-friendly curve that reaches 0 at range; inverse_square = physical 1/d^2 (brighter near the source, uses size), still windowed to range | `smooth` `inverse_square` |
| `size` | number | Emitter radius in meters (inverse_square falloff peak) | 0.001 .. 100 |
| `castShadows` | boolean | Point/spot: occluders block the light (no light through walls). Rendered in the local shadow atlas, cached while nothing in range moves; see shadow_atlas_info |  |
| `shadowBias` | number | Shadow depth bias in meters: raise if lit surfaces show dark speckles (acne), lower if shadows detach from their casters (peter-panning) | 0 .. 1 |
| `shadowNormalBias` | number | Shadow offset along the surface normal in shadow-map texels (acne on surfaces at grazing angles) | 0 .. 8 |
| `shadowResolution` | integer | Shadow map slot hint in px (256 small, 1024 hero light, 2048 max); 0 = automatic from the light's size on screen |  |
| `shadowMaxDistance` | number | Camera distance (m) beyond which this light's shadow fades out (saves atlas space); 0 = no limit | 0 .. 100000 |
| `shadowMode` | string | Point light shadow projection: cube = 6 exact views; dual_paraboloid = 2 views, cheaper to update but approximate for large flat polygons | `cube` `dual_paraboloid` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"light": {}}}
    ```


## `reflection_probe` { #reflection_probe }

A captured cubemap of the scene around this point. Glossy floors, metal and glass inside its influence volume reflect the room or street around them (box-projected so reflections line up with walls) instead of the sky, and take their ambient light from it. Screen-space reflections still win where they find a hit; the probe fills what is off screen; the sky fills the rest. Put one per room or street section (probe_add sizes it to the room), set `interior` for closed rooms so no sky light leaks in, and check it with probe_info and viewport_capture {debug_view: "reflection_probes"}.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | string | Influence volume: box (rooms, corridors, streets) or sphere | `box` `sphere` |
| `size` | number[3] | Box: influence extent in meters, centered on the entity (times its scale). Match the room |  |
| `radius` | number | Sphere: influence radius in meters (times the entity scale) | 0.1 .. 10000 |
| `blendDistance` | number | Meters inside the volume over which the probe fades into neighbors or the sky (0 = hard edge) | 0 .. 1000 |
| `boxProjection` | boolean | Parallax-correct reflections against the volume so they line up with its walls (rooms, corridors); off for open areas and distant scenery |  |
| `projectionSize` | number[3] | Box (m) that reflections are projected onto when it should differ from the influence volume: a street split into several probes projects each onto the whole street (its facades and far ends). [0, 0, 0] = the volume itself |  |
| `projectionOffset` | number[3] | Center of projectionSize's box relative to the entity (m, local axes) |  |
| `intensity` | number | Brightness of the probe's reflections and ambient light | 0 .. 16 |
| `interior` | boolean | Closed room: no sky light inside the volume. Reflections and ambient come only from the probe, and the capture lights its walls with ambientColor instead of the sky (the sky still shows through windows) |  |
| `ambient` | string | Diffuse ambient inside the volume: probe (from the capture, default), sky (the probe only adds reflections), color (ambientColor x ambientEnergy) | `probe` `sky` `color` |
| `ambientColor` | color | Interior captures: the ambient light that replaces the sky's; ambient "color": the ambient inside — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `ambientEnergy` | number | Multiplies ambientColor | 0 .. 100 |
| `update` | string | When to capture: once (cached; re-captured when the probe changes or on probe_bake), on_change (whenever something in range moves or changes), realtime (every `interval` frames) | `once` `on_change` `realtime` |
| `interval` | integer | realtime: frames between captures (1 = every frame, within the face budget) |  |
| `resolution` | integer | Cubemap face size in px: 64, 128, 256 (default) or 512; rounded to a power of two |  |
| `cullMask` | integer | Render layers the capture draws (bit i = layer i+1; 1048575 = all). Leave the player out of realtime probes |  |
| `priority` | integer | Where volumes overlap the higher priority wins (equal: the smaller volume) |  |
| `captureOffset` | number[3] | Capture point relative to the entity in meters (local axes); keep it inside the room, away from walls |  |
| `maxDistance` | number | Capture far plane in meters (0 = automatic from the volume) | 0 .. 20000 |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"reflection_probe": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.reflection_probe.shape          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `camera` { #camera }

A camera. The first primary camera is used when the game runs.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fov` | number | Vertical field of view in degrees | 5 .. 170 |
| `nearPlane` | number | Near clip distance | 0.001 .. 100 |
| `farPlane` | number | Far clip distance | 1 .. 100000 |
| `orthographic` | boolean | Orthographic projection (2D games) |  |
| `orthoSize` | number | Half the visible height in orthographic mode | 0.01 .. 10000 |
| `primary` | boolean | Use this camera for gameplay |  |
| `aperture` | number | Depth of field f-stop: 1.4 very shallow .. 16 deep (0 = off) | 0 .. 64 |
| `focusDistance` | number | Focus distance in meters (0 = autofocus on the frame center) | 0 .. 100000 |
| `motionBlur` | number | Motion blur shutter (0.5 = film-like 180 degrees, 0 = off) | 0 .. 1 |
| `tiltShift` | number | Tilt-shift miniature look: blur above and below a sharp band across the middle of the frame (0 = off, 1 = strong) | 0 .. 1 |
| `cullMask` | integer | Render layers this camera draws (bitmask, bit 0 = layer 1; default all 20). E.g. hide first-person arms from a security camera, or editor-only helpers from the game camera |  |

## `process` { #process }

How this entity and its children run while the game is paused (pause_game) or slowed down (time_scale), the order their behaviors run in, and whether their motion is smoothed between 60 Hz ticks on fast displays. A pause menu canvas runs `always` (UI canvases do by default); enemies stay `pausable`.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | inherit (from the parent; root default pausable) \| pausable (stops while the game is paused) \| when_paused (runs only while paused: pause menu logic) \| always (never stops: UI, music controllers) \| disabled (never runs, still drawn) | `inherit` `pausable` `when_paused` `always` `disabled` |
| `priority` | integer | Behavior run order: lower runs first (ties keep scene order). Not inherited |  |
| `clock` | string | inherit \| game (dt follows time_scale: slow motion) \| real (ignores time_scale: menus, HUD) | `inherit` `game` `real` |
| `interpolation` | string | inherit \| on (motion is smoothed between ticks on screen) \| off (shown exactly at tick positions: snapping things, pixel-art) | `inherit` `on` `off` |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    entity_update {"entity": "Crate", "components": {"process": {}}}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    ```text
    self.process.mode          -- read or write any field
    ```

## `environment` { #environment }

Scene-wide sky, sun, ambient light, fog and exposure.

| Field | Type | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skyTop` | color | Sky color at the zenith — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `skyHorizon` | color | Sky color at the horizon — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `ground` | color | Ambient bounce color from below — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `ambient` | number | Ambient light strength | 0 .. 10 |
| `sunAzimuth` | number | Sun compass direction in degrees (0 = +Z) |  |
| `sunElevation` | number | Sun height above horizon in degrees | -90 .. 90 |
| `sunColor` | color | Sun light color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `sunIntensity` | number | Sun brightness | 0 .. 100 |
| `fogColor` | color | Distance fog color — hex string "#rrggbb[aa]" or [r,g,b(,a)] in 0..1 |  |
| `fogDensity` | number | Exponential fog density (0 = off) | 0 .. 1 |
| `exposure` | number | Camera exposure multiplier | 0.01 .. 20 |
| `autoExposure` | boolean | Adapt exposure to scene brightness (eye adaptation) |  |
| `exposureCompensation` | number | Exposure compensation in EV stops | -6 .. 6 |
| `adaptationSpeed` | number | Auto exposure adaptation speed | 0.05 .. 20 |
| `showGrid` | boolean | Draw the editor ground grid |  |
| `bloomIntensity` | number | Glow around bright/emissive things (0 = off) | 0 .. 5 |
| `bloomThreshold` | number | Brightness where glow starts (lower = more glow) | 0 .. 10 |
| `bloomClamp` | number | Brightest (exposed) value that feeds the glow: 2-8 keeps sun glints, chrome and LED lights crisp instead of blown-out halos; 64 = effectively unlimited | 0.1 .. 64 |
| `saturation` | number | Color saturation (1 = neutral) | 0 .. 2 |
| `contrast` | number | Contrast (1 = neutral) | 0.5 .. 2 |
| `vignette` | number | Darken the image corners | 0 .. 1 |
| `grain` | number | Film grain | 0 .. 1 |
| `chromaticAberration` | number | Lens color fringing toward the frame edges | 0 .. 1 |
| `look` | string | Color grading look | `none` `warm` `cool` `teal_orange` `golden_hour` `bleach` `noir` `vivid` `moonlight` `vintage` |
| `lut` | string | Optional .cube 3D LUT file (project-relative); when set it replaces the look (lookStrength blends it) |  |
| `lookStrength` | number | Strength of the look / LUT | 0 .. 1 |
| `skyMode` | string | gradient = two artist colors; atmosphere = physically inspired sky from the sun; hdri = a photographed .hdr panorama lights and backs the scene (set `hdri`) | `gradient` `atmosphere` `hdri` |
| `hdri` | string | Equirectangular .hdr panorama, project-relative (skyMode hdri) |  |
| `hdriRotation` | number | Panorama rotation in degrees (line its sun up with sunAzimuth) |  |
| `hdriIntensity` | number | Panorama brightness | 0 .. 20 |
| `clouds` | number | Procedural cloud cover | 0 .. 1 |
| `cloudMode` | string | Clouds: volumetric (ray-marched, lit, shadows) or flat (cheap) | `volumetric` `flat` |
| `cloudHeight` | number | Cloud layer base height in meters | 100 .. 12000 |
| `cloudThickness` | number | Cloud layer thickness in meters | 100 .. 10000 |
| `cloudDensity` | number | Cloud density: 0.3 wispy .. 2 stormy | 0 .. 4 |
| `cloudScale` | number | Cloud feature size (0.5 small puffs .. 3 huge banks) | 0.1 .. 8 |
| `cloudSpeed` | number | Cloud drift speed in m/s (along windDirection) | 0 .. 100 |
| `stars` | number | Stars in the night sky | 0 .. 1 |
| `sunSize` | number | Sun / moon disc size | 0.1 .. 8 |
| `fogHeight` | number | Fog pools near the ground as this grows (0 = uniform) | 0 .. 2 |
| `reflections` | number | Sky reflections / image-based lighting strength | 0 .. 3 |
| `ao` | number | Ambient occlusion (contact shadows in corners and creases) | 0 .. 2 |
| `aoRadius` | number | Ambient occlusion radius in meters | 0.05 .. 5 |
| `gi` | number | Screen-space global illumination: bounce and emissive light (0 = sky light only) | 0 .. 1 |
| `giDistance` | number | Global illumination ray length in meters | 0.5 .. 50 |
| `ssr` | number | Screen-space reflections on glossy surfaces (wet streets, floors, metal) | 0 .. 1 |
| `taa` | boolean | Temporal anti-aliasing (smooth edges, stable shimmer-free detail) |  |
| `renderScale` | number | Real-time internal resolution: 0.5-0.77 renders fewer pixels and MetalFX temporal upscaling reconstructs full resolution (faster); 1 = native. Stills and captures with samples &gt; 1 render native. | 0.33 .. 1 |
| `sharpen` | number | Sharpening after temporal anti-aliasing | 0 .. 1 |
| `shadowSoftness` | number | Sun shadow penumbra size | 0 .. 6 |
| `tonemap` | string | HDR to display curve | `aces` `agx` `neutral` `filmic` `none` |
| `temperature` | number | White balance: -1 cool .. +1 warm | -1 .. 1 |
| `tint` | number | White balance: -1 green .. +1 magenta | -1 .. 1 |
| `shadowDistance` | number | Sun shadow range in meters (0 = automatic) | 0 .. 5000 |
| `godRays` | number | Volumetric light: sun shafts through trees and windows, cones under lamps (0 = off, 1 = natural) | 0 .. 8 |
| `haze` | number | Air density for volumetric light, extinction per meter: 0.0003 clear landscape, 0.002 hazy valley, 0.01-0.03 misty alley or interior | 0 .. 1 |
| `windSpeed` | number | Wind (m/s) that carries smoke, rain, snow and particles | 0 .. 60 |
| `windDirection` | number | Direction the wind blows toward (degrees, 0 = +Z) |  |
| `localShadowAtlas` | integer | Point/spot shadow atlas size in px: 2048 (16 MB), 4096 (64 MB, default), 8192 (256 MB) |  |
| `localShadowLights` | integer | Most point/spot lights with shadows per frame (the most important on screen); the rest light without shadows. 0 = no local shadows |  |
| `localShadowUpdates` | integer | Point/spot shadow views re-rendered per frame when lights or casters move (cube light = 6, spot = 1); later updates wait a frame. Stills render all |  |
| `probeBudget` | integer | Reflection probes with a slot in the probe atlas (the most important in view first; the rest fall back to the sky). Max 32; 0 = probes off |  |
| `probeUpdates` | integer | Reflection probe cube faces captured per frame (a whole probe = 6); later captures wait a frame. Stills capture everything |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    environment_update {"preset": "sunset"}
    ```

=== "Wander"

    Environment fields are scene settings, edited with `environment_update` (or keyed in sequences as `environment.<field>`).
